chapter.verse: Leenggahzu in kam tam sakin, khamtheih zu in kitawngsak a, zu khamna in haina ahi hi.
Kumpipa’ hehna in a lauhuai humpinelkai hawk bang hi a, kumpipa a hehsak khate in sih lawh uh hi.
Kitot khak ding pelhna in pahtak ngahna hi a, mihaite bek kitot ding ut uh hi.
Lo khawh hun-a a kho nuam lo thadahpa in, tuk anlak hun ciangin bangmah nei lo ding hi.
Mihingte’ ngaihsutna in a thuk sunga om tui tawh kibang a, thuthuk mu theite bekin suak khia thei hi.
Mi khempeuh in mi citakin kigen kim uh hi; ahi zongin a citak takpi ding mi kimu zo ding ahi hiam?
Mi khat thumanin a hoihin a nuntak leh, ama suan-le-khakte mi hampha ahi uh hi.
Thukhenna tokhom tungah a tu kumpipa in, a mit-in a etna tawh a hoih lote khenkhia thei hi.
“Ka lungsim siangtho hi; mawhna ka nei het kei hi,” a ci thei ding kua om hiam?
Tawisuang nam nih leh piciang nam nih zanga khemna, Topa in a deih lohna kibang hi.
Naupangte nangawn mi citak mihoih ahihna, a gamtatna panun kimukhia thei hi.
Topa in khuamuh nading mit, leh khuazak nading bil hong guan hi.
Lumlum lecin na zawng ding a, semsem lecin na hau ding hi.
Vanleipa in vanzuakpa kiangah, “Kiman kei, kiman kei,” ci ci a, a paikhiat khit ciangin sum dek siam ing, ci-in mi kiangah kisial hi.
Pilna tawh kam na pau theih leh, kham leh suangmanpha sangin a manphazaw a nei na hi hi.
Mi khat in gamdang mi khat’ leiba lohsak dingin kam a haiciam leh, a ciam bangin a neihsa kilaksak takpi ding hi.
A man lo-a kingah an in lim zungzung a, ahi zongin a nung ciangin suangtang hai khak tawh kibang hi.
Hoih tak-a geelna, midangte ngaihsutna dotna tawh nasepna taangtung hi; geelna kician om lopi-in galsim dingin kipan kei in.
Mi a gensia kawikawite muanhuai thei lo hi; tua banga mihai paute tawh kikhawl kei in.
Na nu leh na pa na samsiat leh, khuamial sunga meivak kisumit na bang ding hi.
A baihlam-a hauh pakna in, a tawpna ah phattuamna om lo hi.
Mite’ hong bawlsiatna thukkik ding ngaihsun kei in, Topa ’ hong huh ding ngak in.
Tawisuang nam nih a zangte, Topa in mudah a, amah in tawikhaina man lote hoihsa lo hi.
Topa in mihingte’ gamtat nading uk hi; koici gamtat ding cih mihing in bangci theih ding ahi hiam?
Pasian tungah piak ding na ciam ma-in hoih takin ngaihsun masa in; tua hi kei leh na kinungsik kha ding hi.
A pil kumpipa in migilote tengkhia a, khasiat loin daantat gawp hi.
Topa in mihing lungsim meivak bangin zang a, i sung tawng dong hong entel hi.
Kumpipa in itna tawh thuman, thutang, citakin a uk lai teng, a kumpi za-ah kip bek hi.
Khangnote’ thahatna in amau’ minthan’na hi a, khanghamte’ sam kan’na in amau’ thupina lim ahi hi.
Nakpi tak-a satna in misia kimlai a pha hong suah a, nakpi tak-a vuakna in i sung tawng hoih lohna teng siangsak hi.
